$comment: Compatibility sweep round 13 list (compiled by Android compat round 16; measured on the desktop by desktop sweep round 10 on Electron 44.4.5, baseline 35d69b9a; until then no desktop sweep had run for these ranks, the desktop sweep having returned to its regular cadence with round 8): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round12.json (ranks 361-390; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round13/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-24; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 18,950 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 13 (this round added 316 search terms and 1,351 new detail pages; one of them read the rounded 500,000 bucket or above - Forest: stay focused, be present at 800,000 users - a count that would have placed it in an earlier list had the store's listings or the earlier rounds' terms surfaced it, so it is rank 361 as the highest-count item not yet listed, the earlier lists standing as compiled; the other 1,350 are all below the rounded 500,000 bucket). Every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 500,000 bucket (64 detail pages) was read again on 2026-09-24 after round 15's read of the same day, and no count or rating count had moved. Ranks 362-390 are the rounded 500,000 bucket's 29 rankable items with the most ratings after round 15's nine (its cut fell between Karma at 3.9K ratings and Simplify Copilot at 3.8K, so Simplify Copilot is rank 362) in rating order; the cut falls between 7TV at 203 ratings and Page Ruler at 103, leaving three rankable items in the bucket (Page Ruler, Exporter for Followers, Email Extract). Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 12's comment plus Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, a native-messaging launcher for one HR product's enterprise portals), Google items whose detail pages publish no user count, and three items whose detail pages published no user count on 2026-09-24 although earlier reads had placed them in the 500,000 or 600,000 bucket (OpenDyslexic for Chrome, Helperbird, Mirroring360 Sender for Chrome), there being no count to rank them by. Password Alert and Tag Assistant Companion are Google items whose pages do publish a count and are ranked as Google Voice was.
